verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs say the assistant can take uploaded files and answer questions about them. They also cite large-codebase and long-document analysis, so users get AI-generated analysis of their own data inside the product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of proactive insights or suggestion features (as opposed to Q&A on request), and independent hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files.
Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing.
A million-token context loads an entire large codebase with cross-module dependencies in one pass, enabling whole-project understanding and refactoring.
